meta.title: Rules for the Market
meta.textType: functional: safety rules for a trip

paragraphs: On Friday, January twenty-second, Teacher Kim gave each Explorer a rule sheet. It was for the market trip on Saturday. The sheet said "MARKET RULES" at the top. At the bottom, it said, "Teacher Kim, the Explorers." Lily, Mia, Leo, and May stood around a desk with Teacher Kim. They read the six rules. Rule one said, "Stay with your partner." Rule two said, "Keep your wallet in your front pocket." Rule three said, "If you get lost, go to the information stand and show your club id card." Rule four said, "Write the name of each seller in your notebook." Rule five said, "You needn't buy anything, but say thank you." Rule six said, "Meet at the fruit stall at twelve o'clock."

Then Teacher Kim gave each child a small card. It was a club id card with a green flag and a paw print on the front. Mia's card said "Name: Mia" and "Teacher: Kim." On the back were the contact details of Teacher Kim, with her phone number. "Please keep your card in your wallet," said Teacher Kim. "The information stand is next to the exit of the market." "If you cannot find it, ask a shop assistant for help." Mia held up her card and smiled.

"What if we lose our partner?" asked Mia. Leo put one finger on the sheet. He read rule three again. "If you get lost, go to the information stand," he read. Lily picked up a red pencil. "Rule one is the most important," she said. "If we stay together, we will not lose each other." She drew a red line under rule one. May took some coins out of her pocket. She counted them. "Rule five is easy, because I have only twenty baht," she said.

"Why do we keep our wallets in the front pocket?" asked Leo. "A market is crowded," said Teacher Kim. "You can feel it if someone touches your front pocket." "You don't have to take a lot of money." "Many things at the market are cheap, but some things are expensive." "Please ask the price before you buy." Mia wrote the word "price" in her notebook.

Teacher Kim smiled at the four friends. "If you follow these rules, you will have a safe day," she said. The children put their sheets and cards in their bags. "I will keep mine in a safe place," said Lily. Then the bell rang. The Explorers went home.
text.summary: Teacher Kim gives each Explorer a rule sheet and a club id card for the market trip. The children read the six rules, talk about what to do if they get lost, and learn that they needn't buy anything.
